items.requirement: Clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI using only published commands.
OpenAPI, validation, frozen price/tax/discount/exchange-rate versions, deterministic proration, and Invoice totals agree with the public contract.
Payment capture is durably idempotent; UNKNOWN outcomes are reconciled without a second charge; duplicate and reordered provider events converge.
Concurrent partial refunds never exceed captured amount and every successful payment or refund creates one balanced immutable posting.
Monthly settlement freezes membership, survives leased-worker death, posts once, and keeps CLOSED periods immutable.
Manager disputes, chargebacks, and adjustments preserve the shared refund bound, balanced postings, audit history, and V1 compatibility.
All three fixed sustained scenarios meet their published throughput, latency, recovery, and post-load conservation requirements.
The repository owns meaningful unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance commands.
Tenant boundaries, provider secrets, idempotency material, and private paths are never crossed or exposed.
Codex explains ownership, state, money flow, atomic boundaries, failure handling, and review findings clearly.
Every stage and final handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and checks not run accurately.
